flagged.evidence: Step 2.1 chooses a cylinder with C ⊂ D, obtains bounds, then applies [L3]. But [L3] requires hM ≤ r and Lh < 1 before its existence conclusion; step 2.1 verifies neither inequality. Fixing a cylinder and its bounds first, then shrinking h while retaining those bounds, closes this local proof gap.

Step 1.1 calls x|[a,b] a “C² admissible curve ... (its values lie in Q).” The cited chart definition requires a C² extension to an open interval around [a,b]. The motion definition permits intervals with endpoints read using one-sided derivatives, so values in Q alone do not establish admissibility when [a,b] reaches an endpoint of J. Local existence at those endpoints supplies the extension, making this a small proof gap.
